title: Console backend: retention settings endpoints (policy CRUD, effective policy, enforcement status, audit events)
creator: Ethan Park
project: Enterprise Security & Compliance Foundation: Retention controls + compliance reporting pack
content:
Context
- We’re shipping tenant-configurable retention controls (v1). Console UI needs backend endpoints to:
  1) Read/write retention policy
  2) Display effective policy after precedence/guardrails
  3) Show enforcement status + last run metadata
  4) Emit audit events for any changes (and legal hold / exception toggles where applicable)

Scope for ENG-2926 (backend only)
- Implement endpoints in console-api (BFF) that broker calls to control-plane and surface consolidated views for the Console retention settings page.
- Enforce RBAC and tenant isolation.
- Ensure auditable changes (admin actions -> audit log events).

Non-goals (v1)
- No bulk policy management across many tenants/orgs.
- No customer-facing endpoints for raw operational log retention beyond the datasets explicitly supported by the control plane.

Requirements / UX expectations from Product + Design
- Console must show "Effective policy" (post-guardrails + precedence), not just the configured object.
- Console must show enforcement status for each supported dataset category:
  - audit logs
  - admin activity
  - inference request metadata (where applicable)
  - telemetry/analytics eligible tables (subset)
- Console must show legal hold banner + clear messaging when holds/overrides apply.

API surface (Console -> console-api)
Note: these are Console-facing endpoints (not public API). They should be stable, versioned, and logged.

1) Read configured policy
- GET /console/v1/tenants/{tenantId}/retention/policy
- Response includes:
  - policy: configured object (as stored)
  - source: where it came from (tenant override vs org default) when applicable

2) Write/update policy
- PUT /console/v1/tenants/{tenantId}/retention/policy
- Validates:
  - caller has required role
  - payload matches schema (ENG-2911)
  - "never delete" is rejected unless explicitly permitted by control-plane schema (guardrails)
- Must emit audit event: retention.policy.updated

3) Effective policy (post-eval)
- GET /console/v1/tenants/{tenantId}/retention/policy/effective?env={hosted|dedicated|private}&region={region}
- Response includes:
  - effectivePolicy
  - evaluationMetadata (policy version/hash, precedence decisions, min/max clamp notes)
  - holdsApplied summary (if any)

4) Enforcement status
- GET /console/v1/tenants/{tenantId}/retention/enforcement/status?env={...}&region={...}
- Response includes:
  - datasets[]
    - datasetKey (e.g., AUDIT_LOGS)
    - lastRunAt
    - lastRunResult (success|partial|failed)
    - itemsDeleted / partitionsExpired (if available)
    - backlogEstimate (optional)
    - nextScheduledAt (optional)
    - holdsBlockingDeletion (bool)
    - notes (human-readable)

5) Legal hold & exceptions (read-only for Console page in v1; write in separate ticket if needed)
- For v1, surface flags in read endpoints so UX can indicate holds/overrides.
- Any mutable legal hold operations are owned by ENG-2934 and (later) separate Console controls.

RBAC / Auth
- Require Console admin roles:
  - Hosted: org-admin OR security-admin (TBD; follow Kaitlyn’s standard role mappings)
  - Dedicated/Private: tenant-admin AND security-admin if configured
- console-api must never allow cross-tenant access:
  - tenantId in path must be authorized by session scope
  - do not accept tenantId from request body

Audit logging
- Every write to policy must create an audit log entry containing:
  - actor (user id, email)
  - tenantId/orgId
  - action type: retention.policy.updated
  - before/after diff (redacted as needed)
  - request id / trace id
  - env/region where applicable
- For reads, no audit entry required (avoid noise), but should be traced.

Implementation plan
- console-api handlers:
  - RetentionPolicyController (GET/PUT)
  - RetentionEffectivePolicyController (GET)
  - RetentionEnforcementStatusController (GET)
- Under the hood:
  - ControlPlaneClient methods:
    - getRetentionPolicy(tenantId)
    - putRetentionPolicy(tenantId, payload)
    - getEffectiveRetentionPolicy(tenantId, env, region)
    - getRetentionEnforcementStatus(tenantId, env, region)
  - Add request/response DTOs + strict validation
  - Standardize error mapping:
    - 400 schema validation
    - 403 unauthorized
    - 404 tenant not found
    - 409 optimistic concurrency conflict (if control-plane returns version mismatch)
    - 502/503 upstream control-plane issues
- Feature flag:
  - Gate all endpoints behind retention_controls_v1
  - Return 404 if flag disabled (matches other experimental Console pages)

Testing
- Unit tests:
  - RBAC checks
  - tenantId scoping
  - validation + error mapping
- Integration tests (mock control-plane):
  - effective policy endpoint returns evaluation metadata
  - enforcement status endpoint handles partial data (some datasets not supported in private)
- Security tests:
  - ensure audit event emits on PUT and includes required fields

Acceptance criteria
- Console can successfully:
  - fetch current policy
  - update policy with validation + informative errors
  - fetch effective policy (deterministic, includes clamp/precedence info)
  - fetch enforcement status (per dataset)
- Audit logs record all policy changes with actor + before/after.
- Endpoint behavior consistent across Hosted/Dedicated/Private modes (where supported).
- Feature flag works; no exposure when disabled.

Open questions
- Do we need ETag/version-based writes in v1?
  - Proposed: support optional if-match header from UI; if absent, last-write-wins (documented). Control-plane already tracks policy version (ENG-2911).
- Enforcement status source of truth:
  - audit logs: worker metrics/status from ENG-2920
  - telemetry: partition TTL status from ENG-2921
  - Some streams may not have granular lastRunAt. We should allow nulls with notes.

Links
- Design: DES-144 (Retention settings UX)
- Control plane schema/validation: ENG-2911
- Policy evaluation engine: ENG-2912
- Legal holds: ENG-2934
- Audit logs enforcement worker: ENG-2920
- PR (implementation): sources/github/redwood/pr-18510.json

Progress updates / comments

2025-01-16 (Jada Williams)
- Drafted endpoint shapes with Chloe. Aligning response shape with expected Console wireframes (effective policy + enforcement status panel).
- Sync with Marcus on audit event fields; will follow existing admin-action audit format.

2025-01-22 (Kaitlyn Nguyen)
- RBAC note: require security-admin OR org-admin; for Dedicated/Private, also ensure tenant membership is enforced (session must include tenant scope). Don’t rely on client-provided tenantId.

2025-01-29 (Jordan Lee)
- Effective policy response should include evaluation metadata (policyHash, clampedFields) so Console can show "Adjusted by guardrails" messaging. Please don’t attempt to re-evaluate in console-api; treat control-plane as source of truth.

2025-02-04 (Jada Williams)
- Implemented handlers + DTOs; wired to ControlPlaneClient. Added audit event emission on PUT with before/after diff computed from returned control-plane resource.
- Added feature flag enforcement (retention_controls_v1). When disabled, routes return 404.

2025-02-07 (Chloe Martin)
- Review request: ensure enforcement status endpoint returns stable datasetKey values; UI will map keys to display strings. Avoid sending localized display names from backend.

2025-02-11 (Marcus Lin)
- Security review feedback:
  - Ensure we do not log full policy bodies at INFO level (may include customer-specific retention requirements). Keep policy payload logging at DEBUG with redaction or omit.
  - Audit log event must include request id and actor email.
  - Ensure 403 does not leak tenant existence.

2025-02-13 (Jada Williams)
- Addressed security feedback:
  - removed request body logging
  - added traceId/requestId to audit event
  - standardized 403 responses

2025-02-18 (Ethan Park)
- Approved for merge contingent on passing integration tests in canary env. Please coordinate with Connor on release timing since Console UI PR is queued.

2025-02-20 (Jada Williams)
- Merged via PR-18510. Endpoints live behind feature flag in staging; Console team can proceed with wiring UI.
- Follow-up: add optional If-Match support in a small patch if UI hits race conditions during concurrent edits.

Follow-ups (not in scope, tracked elsewhere)
- Add write operations for legal hold / exceptions UI (ENG-2934 follow-on)
- Add compliance pack export endpoint (INT-912)
- Expand enforcement status detail once telemetry tables finalize (ENG-2921)

Notes for Support/Sales enablement
- Policy changes are auditable: every update is recorded in audit logs with actor + timestamp.
- Effective policy view shows guardrail clamps and holds; should help with evidence screenshots for compliance reporting pack v1.
